model: synthetic 37-bus, 93-line network, not actual utility infrastructure; fixed PQ dispatch, idealized Q and slack
limits: This is a synthetic network, not BC Hydro N-1 security.
When --full-ac-n1 is selected, all 140160 x 93 synthetic AC contingency cases are solved; no real-grid validation is implied.
No corrective AC redispatch, no fault/dynamic stability, transformer/VAR certificates, or physical nodal constraints.
DC N1 thermal screen is based on 1/x and fixed injections, excludes voltage and reactive power.
PQ reactive load 4% of modeled active load is an assumed idealized compensation.
